poor.quote: Suddenly the green yard appears to me; it has already swallowed my room.
long shaggy wool leaps with them
Savage fury tears at itself, unable to break loose entirely from a deep muzzle, and only tosses up a heap of wool.
why does fear and hatred melt together
draw a little blood from my calf
Well, and what about me? How?
the tufts of wool knocked loose from her backside

good.quote: It taps its little hammer against a great crystal bell
Ah, how much there is of everything: of sky, of sun, of cheerful green.
Large white sheepdogs, like bears, leap up on their hind legs
Red eyes leap, a broad forehead leaps, and white furry legs.
Ah, what a trifle! What a trifle, if only you knew…
drives your fiery rage back into you
dashed off blindly, out of her senses
